## Definition

Classic Adyen for Platforms is the legacy platform integration addressed by Adyen's Classic guides, distinct from the current Adyen for Platforms balance-platform model. The 2021-modified split-payment guide captured 2026-09-15 describes shopper payment funds allocated to Classic platform accounts by `accountCode`: the seller account holder's account receives the sale allocation and the platform's liable account receives a fee or other liable allocation. `MarketPlace` identifies another platform-account split, while types such as `Commission` or `VAT` are directed to the liable account. [[source-adyen-docs-classic-platforms-processing-payments]]

## Evidence boundary

This source is for existing Classic integrations and routes new implementations to a separate guide. Missing split instructions and certain invalid destinations can book the full amount to the liable account; capture and refund instructions have separate precedence and conditions. The guide's examples do not establish merchant-of-record status, current eligibility, an actual payment authorization, capture, credited funds, payout or bank receipt. Keep Classic `accountCode`/liable-account semantics distinct from current Platforms `balanceAccount`/transfer-instrument resources.
